exposure: Continuous vs. interrupted sutures in the inner myometrial layer
Type of placenta previa (total vs. non-total)
continuous versus interrupted sutures in the inner myometrial layer
uterine myometrial suture techniques at prior caesarean section
cohort: Women with placenta previa, a history of one or more prior caesarean sections, and a history of uterine transverse incision and usage of only absorbable thread for myometrial sutures at the prior caesarean section
finding: Continuous sutures on the inner side of the uterine wall were significantly associated with the development of placenta accreta in women with placenta previa and prior caesarean section.
